remarks: Country Club living at Fawn Ridge Condominiums in the Cranbury area of Norwalk on the Wilton border. The entrance is from the courtyard in front...beautiful! Walk right in (two steps) to the main living area, eat in kitchen, EXTRA DEN and attached garage (walk the groceries right into the kitchen!). Primary and 2nd bedroom both have full baths and walk in closets! Full basement and laundry in the unit. Lots of visitor parking! Central air. Fantastic complex with beautiful well-manicured landscaping, pool & tennis court. Conveniently located near Cranbury Park, shopping, major highways and public transportation.
